findings.problem: Equal sibling keys for SQL/metadata caused retained editors during production React refresh
findings.fix: Unique key namespaces and explicit single editor ownership; one-editor invariant across metadata refresh

findings.problem: Native Quit silently rolled back an active manual transaction; forgiving status errors could be mistaken for safety
findings.fix: Strict parallel fresh status with a 5-second SDK timeout/cancellation. Status failure cannot erase a previously known open transaction. Active, failed, busy, opening or unavailable leases block shutdown; reject new windows during the barrier
findings.verification: 44 live PostgreSQL cases and 25 production Electron Data cases passed on the recorded macOS working-tree snapshot. Current Windows source and packaged acceptance pending.

findings.problem: Untitled and failed recovery flush were not protected at native shutdown; separate native editor remained editable during recovery
findings.fix: Native IDE preflight suspends the separate view, drains accepted bridge mutations and checks actual dirty documents before disposal. File-backed recovery is confirmed by POST plus exact GET readback; unsupported dirty documents require Save As. Failed persistence cancels shutdown and restores the view
findings.verification: 45 live Electron/Theia regression cases passed on current macOS source; exact guards additionally reviewed. Windows pending.

findings.problem: An already accepted stop/restart could finish its async preparation after global shutdown changed ownership; late preparation must not freeze or destroy a restored editor
findings.fix: Check close epoch and suspended ownership after readiness and after executeJavaScript. Main rejects new IDE mutations during shutdown; local stop/restart rejects concurrent suspended ownership and rechecks global shutdown before destroying a view
findings.verification: 45 live Electron/Theia regression cases passed on current macOS source; exact guards additionally reviewed. Windows pending.

findings.problem: A timed-out offline recovery write could publish its old snapshot after a newer retry because timeout alone does not cancel filesystem I/O
findings.fix: Per-file serialized recovery publisher with timeout cancellation token; stale attempt checks before publish; queue prevents an already-issued old OS rename from overtaking newer publication
findings.verification: Two actual temporary-filesystem delayed-sync/cancellation/superseding tests and 45 live IDE regression cases passed; Windows pending.

findings.problem: A later parallel acceptance rerun exposed a readiness gap: the selected result could differ from the page currently available for grid editing
findings.fix: canEdit now requires page.id === resultId and page.offset === offset. DOM result identity/editability and aria-busy expose actual readiness; the UI test waits for the latest completed job's result ID before F2
findings.verification: 44 live PostgreSQL cases and 25 production Electron Data cases passed on the recorded macOS working-tree snapshot. Current Windows source and packaged acceptance pending.

findings.problem: Classic Windows scrollbars appearing during drag can change viewport content size and recenter a graph card below its pointer
findings.fix: Observe allocated border-box rather than classic scrollbar content resize; fit uses current client size. Regression requires 55x25 screen-pixel pointer tracking within 2px across scrollbar appearance at reduced zoom.
findings.verification: Current macOS 25-case Electron acceptance passed, including classic scrollbar geometry regression. Historical Windows a922fac failed; retained failed-run evidence is not a current pass.

findings.problem: A close confirmation could roll back work submitted by a second window/agent; completed changes and transaction calls may create no new query job.
findings.fix: Synchronous close fence, fresh UI recheck and host-owned activityRevision for all mutating dispatch. expectedCloseActivity is compared inside the per-console queue before Rollback. Host rejects hiding busy/active/failed sessions and rejects new mutations after hide; background reads cannot erase a refusal.
findings.verification: 44 actual PostgreSQL cases include both close/query orders, manual table changes without a new job, rollbackTo invalidation and retained private/public values. 25 actual Data UI cases include a real second request while the rollback question is open.

findings.problem: Pinned Python unittest adapter cancelled the structured result pipe at process exit; async decoder callbacks could also be disposed by an earlier onClose. FAIL in output did not guarantee a native test result.
findings.fix: Version/full-SHA checked reversible patch for pinned Python 2026.4.0: final same-stream result/coverage barrier, unittest-only queued callback drain, explicit incomplete error within 6s and immediate user cancellation. Native test bridge returns a fresh run ID, blocks overlapping starts and preserves an unknown-start fence.
findings.verification: 18 deterministic regression cases passed with actual extracted upstream adapter/pipe and real Python sender, including negative controls. Full current macOS IDE45 passed native fresh PASS -> intentional structured FAIL -> repaired PASS. Windows pending.

findings.problem: A screenshot of a minimized native IDE could wait indefinitely; timestamp-only names could collide across parallel captures.
findings.fix: Explicit hidden/minimized/zero-size refusal; 10s native capture deadline with no focus or visibility changes; post-capture identity/bounds/visibility and nonempty image checks; UUID artifact names. Test captures have phase-specific deadlines.
findings.verification: Current IDE45 actual Electron run verified minimized refusal without an artifact, restored only the fixture-owned window and captured real native IDE in both themes. Windows pending.

findings.problem: A test dispatched window.new after fast rejected shutdown had already ended, mislabelling a valid new window as a barrier bypass.
findings.fix: Probe window.new from the actual renderer prepareClose event before its readyToClose acknowledgement, establishing the tested interval without an arbitrary delay.
findings.verification: Current 25-case real Electron/PostgreSQL acceptance passed. The production shutdown guard was retained.
